title: Merged PR promised to close an issue that is still open
author: nisaba
description: Compares merged pull request bodies (closes/fixes/resolves #N) against the issue tracker by exact issue number, and surfaces a still-open issue whose closing promise is more than a day stale as the seam gap. The second real recipe, proving RECIPES/ holds more than one at a time.
confidence_notes: Age-gated, not flat: a promised close under 24 hours old scores 0.55 (below the 0.70 bar, shown as a weighed-and-dropped coincidence, not hidden) because auto-close can lag or a human simply hasn't looked yet; at or past 24 hours it scores a flat 0.85, since 'still open a full day after a keyword-matched merge' is an unambiguous, non-fuzzy signal with no further keyword fuzziness to misfire on. An issue already closed, or a PR naming no closing keyword at all, is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden, the same as scan.py's excluded list.
